name: Gupton Farm Campsite
accommodation: About 50 pitches for tents and campervans (five campervan pitches, some hardstanding), two Landpods sleeping up to four, and the Gupton Bunkhouse for groups
suitableFor: Campers, campervan travellers, families and groups
dogs: Welcome, up to two per pitch
beachAccess: About a ten-minute walk through the fields to Freshwater West
boardStorage: Not stated; space to dry wetsuits and a hot outdoor shower
confirmedFeatures: Toilets, showers, accessible toilet and shower, electric hook-up, washing-up area, chemical disposal, Wi-Fi, campfires and raised BBQs allowed, shop, shared barn (the hwb), wetsuit drying space, hot outdoor shower
overview: Gupton Farm is a National Trust campsite set just behind the dunes at Freshwater West, with a field walk of around ten minutes down to the beach. It takes tents and campervans, has two Landpods and a bunkhouse for groups, and runs a seasonal opening from spring to early November.
surfTripFit: It is the closest place to sleep to Freshwater West, and the wetsuit drying space and hot outdoor shower are built for people coming off the beach.
